parts:

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: I have the standard plan... but only one user can run the app at a given time...
parts: I'm not 100% sure about this, but I believe you might be able to change some settings. What's probably happening is that the app thinks "ok, once 10 users are connected, THEN I'll create a new instance for any new users" (I made up that number), and you might want to change that number to 1.  Just a guess. Look at this article , it could help you http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/scaling-and-tuning.html
